data.gender_notes: Vitusiel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Vitus, meaning 'life' or 'vitality'. In Christian tradition, Vitusiel may refer to the patron saint Vitus, who was believed to protect against epilepsy, madness, and other neurological conditions. The name Vitusiel carries the meaning “Life of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Vitusiel usually hope their child will grow to embody life of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to a child believed to be blessed by God.
data.etymology: Vitusiel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Life of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vitusiel total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Vitus and Modestus were martyred during the persecution of Emperor Diocletian in AD 303-311. Vitusiel is believed to be named after St. Vitus, the patron saint of Bohemia.
The name Vitusiel gained popularity during the Middle Ages in Europe, particularly in regions under the influence of St. Vitus, such as Bohemia and Moravia.
